description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

description.zh: 修改后的IP地址或者域名。
description.en: The updated IP address or domain name.

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The unique ID of the address.
The attribution information of the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
修改后的地址健康状态判定条件：

- any_ok：所有探测模板至少一个探测正常。

- p30_ok：所有探测模板至少30%探测正常。

- p50_ok：所有探测模板至少50%探测正常。

- p70_ok：所有探测模板至少70%探测正常。

- all_ok：所有探测模板全部探测正常。
description.en:
The updated condition for determining the health status of the address:

- any\_ok: At least one probe is normal for all health check templates.

- p30\_ok: At least 30% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- p50\_ok: At least 50% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- p70\_ok: At least 70% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- all\_ok: All probes are normal for all health check templates.
The list of health check tasks.

description.zh:
健康检查探测的目标地址服务端口，当健康检查选择Ping协议时，不支持服务端口的配置。

- 传入参数为空：删除当前已配置的端口号；

- 传入参数不为空：根据传入参数更新端口号；
description.en:
The service port of the target address for the health check. You cannot configure a service port if the health check uses the ping protocol.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured port is deleted.

- If you specify a value for this parameter, the port is updated to the specified value.

description.zh:
地址关联的健康探测模板ID。如果配置了健康检查的端口号，此参数必填。

- 传入参数为空：删除当前已配置的探测模板；

- 传入参数不为空：根据传入参数更新探测模板；
description.en:
The ID of the health check template associated with the address. This parameter is required if you configure a health check port.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured health check template is deleted.

- If you specify a value for this parameter, the health check template is updated to the specified value.
The updated name of the address.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --name Address-1 --address 223.5.XX.XX --attribute-info '当前版本不支持此参数，不需要传入此参数。' --health-judgement p50_ok --health-tasks Port=80 TemplateId=mtp-895180524251000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateCloudGtmAddress --region cn-hangzhou --AttributeInfo '当前版本不支持此参数，不需要传入此参数。' --HealthJudgement p50_ok --HealthTasks '[{"Port":80,"TemplateId":"mtp-895180524251000000"}]' --Address '223.5.XX.XX' --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --AddressId 'addr-895182181143680000' --Name 'Address-1'
